title: Scene Breakdown Section Combined Semantic and Visual LLM Input V2
description: Scene model input with exact frozen narration, narrative markers, section-local visual cadence guidance, and approved visual context. Raw pacing policy/density and planned narration WPM are deliberately not exposed.

section_context.description: Section identity and immutable source narration.

section_id.description: The exact Script section ID being processed.

section_order.description: The one-based order of the section in the Script.

section_role.description: The authored section role in the complete Script.

script_text.description: The complete authoritative section narration. It must be partitioned verbatim into returned beats.

analysis_guidance.description: Script Analysis narrative-marker guidance. Raw pacing density is intentionally omitted from Scene model context.

important_narrative_markers.description: Important narrative markers with exact marker text from the authoritative source span.

items.description: One narrative marker that should influence semantic partitioning.

marker_id.description: The exact narrative marker ID from Script Analysis.

importance.description: How strongly the marker should influence semantic segmentation.

purpose.description: The Script Analysis explanation of why the marker matters.

script_text.description: The exact source text covered by this marker span.

visual_context.description: Approved project visual context used to design the returned beat visuals. Apply it without repeating global style instructions in each beat.

style.description: Approved project-wide Style Bible context. It is the only creative-style source for this call.

medium.description: Approved project-wide visual medium. Apply it implicitly to every beat and do not repeat it in beat output.

linework.description: Approved project-wide treatment of outlines, strokes, contours and drawn edges. Apply it implicitly and do not repeat it in beat output.

rendering.description: Approved project-wide rendering treatment, including detail level, shading, dimensionality and finish. Apply it implicitly and do not repeat it in beat output.

palette.description: Approved global color palette. Apply it globally; do not copy this complete list into beat-level color_emphasis.

character_style.description: Approved appearance rules for characters, or null when the Style Bible defines no separate character rules. Apply them when a character appears and do not repeat them in beat output.

environment_style.description: Approved appearance rules for locations and environments, or null when none are separately defined. Apply them when an environment appears and do not repeat them in beat output.

prop_style.description: Approved appearance rules for props, or null when none are separately defined. Apply them when a prop appears and do not repeat them in beat output.

subject_style.description: Approved appearance rules for recurring visual subjects, or null when none are separately defined. Apply them when a recurring subject appears and do not repeat them in beat output.

global_avoid.description: Approved project-wide visual characteristics that must not appear. Apply them globally and do not copy the complete list into beat output.

editorial_language.description: Required approved channel-level editorial visual language forwarded from the Style Bible. It guides how locked meaning is represented, never what the Beat means.

reference_catalog.description: Section-relevant semantic references. Use only IDs and categories supplied here.

continuity_notes.description: Stable identity or state facts that should remain consistent across repeated appearances of this reference.

presence_range_prompt.description: Authoritative Script Analysis range where this exact canonical entity remains narratively active even when individual beats use pronouns, shorthand, or implicit continuation.
